---
title: "Day 2 – The full-day format"
---

The second day is the [full-day format](../day/index.qmd) on the Housing and racial bias case study, unchanged, and its pages carry the steps of each part. You do the tasks in the workspace, and the slides of the full-day format, which run R inside your browser, show each step and carry the work if your installation fails. After the first day the morning in the full-day format goes faster, since credibility, the three Rs and the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026) are familiar, and the time that it saves goes to the tasks.

[Start the full-day format at Part 1](../day/part-1.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Open the slides](../../live/day.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

- **[Part 1 – The claim and credibility](../day/part-1.qmd).** The case study and its claim, with the setup check of Task 1.
- **[Part 2 – The estimand and the causal graph](../day/part-2.qmd).** The five analysts, estimands and causal graphs, and the estimand statement and the graph of Task 2.
- **[Part 3 – The reproduction](../day/part-3.qmd).** One of the five reanalyses reproduced in Task 3, and what a reproduction needs.
- **[Part 4 – Robustness](../day/part-4.qmd).** The menu of Task 4 and the class chart, the curve, the replication, and the analysis that you declare in Task 5.

**By the end of the day** you have one analysis declared in the preregistration block of your report, run and sent to the class chart, which the third day writes up.
